title: Danau language
extract: Danau, also spelled Htanaw or Danaw, is an Austroasiatic language of Myanmar (Burma). It is the most divergent member of the Palaungic branch. According to community estimates (2023), Danau is spoken by about 3,000 people in six villages near Aungban, Kalaw Township, Shan State. Danau was described as a "critically endangered" language in UNESCO's 2010 Atlas of the World’s Languages in Danger.
